study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected data
cohort: 4,127 low-risk pregnant women with normal pregestational body mass index (18.5-24.9 kg/m(2)) and no pregestational or gestational complications giving birth at term between January 2016 and December 2020.
finding: Abnormal gestational weight gain was independently associated with a heightened risk of adverse outcomes among healthy, low-risk pregnant women with normal pregestational BMI and no comorbidity or gestational complications.
